title: Warpage before and after cycling, control group design

step3_rows.testsToBePerformed: Group A (H01-H05, control): precondition, warpage during reflow simulation
step3_rows.specificationRevision: SYN-TM-101 Rev C; SYN-PR-201 Rev B

step3_rows.testsToBePerformed: Group B (H06-H10): precondition, thermal cycling -40 C to 125 C for 200 cycles, precondition again, warpage during reflow simulation
step3_rows.specificationRevision: SYN-TM-110 Rev D; SYN-PR-201 Rev B; SYN-TM-101 Rev C

fields.additionalInformation:
Objective: compare warpage before and after thermal cycling.
Design: two groups of 5 instead of measuring the same 10 parts twice, because SYN-TM-101 does not allow a second reflow profile on the same samples unless stated, and a second profile would change the parts. Group A is the before (control) group, group B the after group.
Thermal profile for warpage: peak 260 C, same profile as EX-01 (attached). Measurement area: terminal seating plane, datum = three standoffs. Cycling profile: 15 min dwell, 10 C/min ramp.
Precondition again after cycling and before the warpage run, as SYN-PR-201 requires before every elevated-temperature test.
Samples: as-molded, dry-packed since molding.
Acceptance: compare group B coplanarity against group A; limit 0.10 mm at peak.
Report: coplanarity table per sample, before/after comparison plot.

_why_good: Explains the test design choice (control group) and the rule behind it.
Keeps 5 samples per condition, the procedure minimum.
Repeats preconditioning before each thermal step.
Lets the lab see the whole sequence per group in one place.
